title: MusicDrop v1.5.7 Available
changelog:
• Glassmorphic Player for Audio: Full translucent frosted glass panels, glowing glass borders, and iridescent gradient fallback when playing audio songs
• Voice Notes & Non-Music Separation: Voice recordings (e.g. WhatsApp notes, call recordings, timestamped audio clips) are now cleanly segregated into a dedicated Recordings category, keeping Songs and Downloads pure music
• Streamlined Library Tabs with 'More ▾' Popup: Replaced crowded 9-tab row with primary tabs + smart 'More ▾' dropdown (Albums, Artists, Genres, Folders), completely eliminating text truncation ('Gen...')
• Mini Player Glassmorphism: Translucent frosted glass mini-player bar with dynamic card opacity
• Fully responsive button spacing and layout polish across all devices
